Total bank credit contracted, hinting at a small pullback in lending. Commercial loan growth and expanding deposits suggest credit is still flowing. Treasury balances fell, while foreign official holdings declined, pointing to reduced external demand. Overall, the market leans toward marginally looser liquidity but retains some pressure points.
